senses.gloss:
पौर 1. पौर, अस्, m. (fr. 1. पुर् or fr. rt.
पॄ?), Ved. ‘filling, sating,’ an epithet of Soma (Sāy.
= उदर-पूरक); ‘filler, increaser,’ an epithet of
the Aśvins; an epithet of Indra (Sāy. = पूरयितृ);
N. of a Ṛṣi the author of the hymns Ṛg-veda V.
73, 74; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a dynasty.

पौर 2. पौर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुर, see 3. पुर्),
belonging to a town or city, produced in a town
or city; (अस्), m. a townsman, burgher, citizen (op-
posed to जानपद); = नागर, a term for a prince
engaged in war under certain circumstances and (in
astrology) applied to a planet in a state of opposition
to other planets; (ई), f. the language or conversation
of the servants in a palace; (अम्), n. a species of
[]
fragrant grass (= रौहिष).
—पौर-जन, अस्, m.
a person belonging to the town, townsman, citizen.
—पौर-जानपद, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging to town
and country; (आस्), m. pl. citizens and rustics, towns-
men and country people.
—पौर-योषित्, त्, or
पौर-स्त्री or पौराङ्गना (˚र-अङ्˚), f. a woman
living in a town or city.
—पौर-लोक, आस्, m. pl.
city people, citizens.
—पौर-वृद्ध, अस्, m. a
distinguished or eminent citizen, alderman.
—पौर-
सख्य, अम्, n. fellow-citizenship, connection or
equality with others formed by inhabiting the same
city for ten years.

पौरक, अस्, m. a garden in the neighbourhood
of a city; a garden round a house.

पौरञ्जन, अस्, ई, अम्, sprung or descended
from Purañ-jana and Purañ-janī.

पौरन्दर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुरन्-दर), be-
longing or relating to Indra, derived or coming from
Indra, sacred to Indra; (अम्), n. the Nakṣatra
Jyeṣṭhā.
पौरिक पौरिक. See above.

पौरेय, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging or relating to a
town or city, civic.
पौरेय पौरेय. See col. 1.

पौरव पौरव, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पूरु), be-
longing to or descended from Pūru, of the race of
Pūru; (अस्), m. a descendant of Pūru; (आस्), m. pl.
the descendants or the race of Pūru; N. of a people
in the north or north-east of India; (ई), f., N. of the
wife of Vasu-deva; of the wife of Yudhi-ṣṭhira.
पौरवक, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.

पौरवतन्तव, अस्, m. (probably fr. पूरु +
तन्तु), in पर-प्˚, q. v.

पौरवीय, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पूरु), devoted to
Paurava.

पौरस्त्य पौरस्त्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. पुरस्),
situated in front, foremost; eastern; previous, pre-
ceding, former, prior, first, initial.

पौराण पौराण, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुराण),
belonging or relating to the past, of the past, of
ancient occurrence, derived from or belonging to
past ages, primeval, ancient; belonging to former
times, former, previous; relating to the Purāṇas.

पौराणिक, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging or relating to
the past or to past ages; familiar with the events
and legends of the past; relating or belonging to
the Purāṇas, Paurānic; worth a Purāṇa, of the
value of one Purāṇa; (अस्), m. a Brāhman well-
read in the Purāṇas or a public expounder of them;
a mythologist.

पौरुकुत्स पौरुकुत्स, अस्, or पौरुकुत्सि,
इस्, or पौरुकुत्स्य, अस्, m. (fr. पुरु-कुत्स), a
patronymic of Trasa-dasyu.

पौरुमद्ग पौरुमद्ग, अम्, n., N. of a
Sāman.

पौरुमह्न पौरुमह्न, अम्, n. (fr. पुरु-
मह्न), N. of various Sāmans.

पौरुमीढ पौरुमीढ or पौरुमीऌह, अम्,
n. (fr. पुरु-मीढ), N. of various Sāmans.

पौरुशिष्टि पौरुशिष्टि, इस्, m. (fr. पुरु +
शिष्ट), Ved., N. of a teacher.

पौरुष पौरुष, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुरुष),
belonging or relating to a man or to man in general,
manly, virile, human; relating or belonging to Pu-
rusha, sacred to Puruṣa; being of the length of a
man with both arms elevated and the fingers ex-
tended; (अस्), m. (according to Kullūka) = पुरुष-
वाह्य-भार, a weight or load which can be carried
by one man; (ई), f. a woman; (अम्), n. manhood,
manliness, manly strength or courage, heroism,
strength, power, vigour; human action, action of
men, man's work, action; effort, exertion; the
measure of a man, the height to which he reaches
[]
with both arms elevated and the fingers extended;
generation; semen virile; the penis; a sun-dial.
—पौरुष-ता, f. or पौरुष-त्व, अम्, n. man-
hood, manly strength or spirit.

पौरुषमेधिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुरुष-
मेध), Ved. relating or belonging to a human
sacrifice.

पौरुषविधिक, अस्, ई, अम्, = पुरुष-विध,
man-like, resembling man, human.

पौरुषांसकिन्, इनस्, m. pl. the school of Pu-
ruṣāṃsaka.

पौरुषाद, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुरुषाद), relating
or belonging to man-eaters or cannibals.
पौरुषिक, अस्, m. a worshipper of Puruṣa.

पौरुषेय, अस्, ई, अम्, derived from or relating
to man, incidental to man, made by man, human,
manly, male, virile; coming from the soul, spiritual;
(अस्), m. a hireling, day-labourer; a crowd or num-
ber of men (?); manslaughter, murder; law as
affecting persons; (अम्), n. human action, the work
of man.
—पौरुषेय-त्व, अम्, n. humanity, human
origin, the human element (in sacred writings).

पौरुष्य, अस्, -षी, अम्, relating to Puruṣa;
(अम्), n. manliness, manly strength or courage.

पौरुहन्मन पौरुहन्मन, अम्, n. (fr. पुरु-
हन्मन्), N. of various Sāmans.

पौरुहूत पौरुहूत, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुरु-
हूत), belonging to Indra.

पौरूरवस पौरूरवस, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging
or relating to Purū-ravas; (अस्), m. a patronymic.

पौरोगव पौरोगव, अस्, m. (fr. पुरो-गव),
an overseer or superintendent of a royal household,
especially the inspector of the royal kitchen.

पौरोडाश, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुरो-डाश), see Gaṇa
to Pāṇ. IV. 4, 62; (अस्), m. a Mantra recited upon
making an oblation of clarified butter.

पौरोडाशिक, अस्, m. (fr. पुरो-डाश), a priest
who recites the Mantra used in offering an oblation
of clarified butter.

पौरोधस, अस्, m. a patronymic from Puro-dhas;
(अम्), n. the office or function of a family priest.

पौरोभाग्य, अम्, n. (fr. पुरो-भागिन्), envy,
jealousy, malevolence, ill-will, censoriousness; ob-
trusiveness.

पौरोहित, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुरो-हित), belonging
to a Puro-hita, coming or proceeding from a family
priest.

पौरोहित्य, अस्, -ती, अम्, belonging to the family
of a Puro-hita; (अम्), n. the character or office of a
family priest.

पौर्णदर्व पौर्णदर्व, अम्, n. = पूर्ण-
दर्व, q. v.

पौर्णमास, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पूर्ण-मास), re-
lating or belonging to the full moon, usual or cus-
tomary at full moon, having the full moon; (अस्,
अम्), m. n. a ceremony performed at the full moon
by persons maintaining a perpetual fire; a patro-
nymic; N. of a son of Marīci and Sambhūti; of a
prince of the Āndhra dynasty; (अम्), n. a day of
full moon; (ई), f. a day or night of full moon.

पौर्णमासायन, अम्, n. (fr. the preceding),
Ved. a kind of sacrifice offered at the full moon.

पौर्णमासिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पौर्णमास),
used for the sacrifice offered at the full moon.

पौर्णमास्य, अम्, n., scil. कर्मन्, a sacrifice
offered at the full moon.
पौर्णमी, f. a day of full moon (= पूर्णिमा).

पौर्णिम, अस्, m. (fr. पूर्णिमा), an ascetic;
(आ), f. a day of full moon.

पौर्त पौर्त, अम्, n. (fr. पूर्त), scil. कर्-
मन्, a meritorious work (= पूर्त).

पौर्तिक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating or belonging to a
meritorious work (as the feeding of a Brāhman
&c.).

पौर्व पौर्व, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पूर्व), relating
or belonging to the past; relating to the east,
eastern.

पौर्वदेहिक or पौर्वदैहिक, अस्, ई, अम्
(fr. पूर्व-देह), belonging or relating to a former
body, belonging or relating to a former life or
existence; derived from a former existence, done in
a former life.

पौर्वपञ्चालक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पूर्व-पञ्-
चाल), = पूर्वः पञ्चालानाम्.

पौर्वपदिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पूर्व-पद),
relating to the first member of a compound; (pro-
bably) pronouncing the first member of a compound
(in teaching).

पौर्ववर्षिक, अस्, ई, अम्, = पूर्वासु वर्-
षासु भवः, Scholiast on Pāṇ. VII. 3, 11.

पौर्वशाल, अस्, ई, अम्, = पूर्वस्यां शालायाम्
भवः, Scholiast on Pāṇ. IV. 2, 107.

पौर्वातिथ, अस्, m., Ved. a patronymic from
Pūrvātithi; (अम्), n., N. of a Sāman.

पौर्वापर्य, अम्, n. (fr. पूर्वापर), priority
and posteriority, the relation of prior and posterior,
succession, continuity.

पौर्वार्ध or पौर्वार्धिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr.
पूर्वार्ध), living or situated on the eastern side
of (with gen.).

पौर्वाह्णिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पूर्वाह्ण), be-
longing or relating to the morning, produced in the
forenoon, matutinal; (often wrongly spelt पौर्वाह्-
निक.)

पौर्विक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पूर्व), former, pre-
vious, prior, primary; ancient, old; ancestral; (ई),
f. an ancestress.
